days.label: Friday
days.text: Friday night has plenty of range. Comedian Kurt Braunohler , with credits in "The Big Sick" and "Bob's Burgers," headlines Vermont Comedy Club at 7. Country and folk fans can catch Waylon Wyatt with Tristan Trincado at the Higher Ground Ballroom at 8:30, Barbie N Bones plays a free rock show at the Old Post at 7, and Dan Parks plays a live set at the Saint John's Club at 6. The Skinny Pancake's free Dancing in the Streets series has Local Strangers on the waterfront patio from 8 to 11, covering a spectrum from the Grateful Dead to Aretha Franklin. Dancers get choices of their own tonight. The Mad Robin Contra Dance returns to downtown after a 7 year hiatus at the First Congregational Church, beginner lesson at 7:40 and dancing 8 to 11, the Queer Country Line Dance takes over Four Quarters in Winooski with doors at 7 and beginner friendly instruction, and Untapped ($15) , Vermont's longest running drag and burlesque show, hosts a rotating cast at the Monkey House at 8, 21 plus. Theater people can catch Falsettos at Main Street Landing's Blackbox Theater at 7, playing through August 23. If you would rather chase the sunset, a waterfront walk and creemee stroll [MEETUP] meets behind ECHO at 7 for an easy loop to the Sweet Spot creemee stand. Out in Essex, G. Love and Special Sauce play the Old Stage at the Double E at 7, and the Adult Rummikub crowd meets at the Essex Free Library from 1 to 3.

days.label: Saturday
days.text: Saturday earns that forecast. Our own BTown Coffee Club [MEETUP] holds down Zero Gravity Brewery at 10, grab a coffee and come say hi. The Burlington Farmers Market runs 9 to 2 at 345 Pine Street with more than 70 vendors, and the Board Game Brunch [MEETUP] deals out at Old Town Cafe & Comics in Williston from 9 to noon. The Old North End Repair Cafe runs 11 to 3 at Laboratory B, where volunteers fix anything you can carry in for free, knife sharpening included. Collectors can hit the Vermont Sports Card & Collectible Show at 155 Dorset Street in South Burlington starting at 10 to buy, sell and trade. Bookstore Romance Day takes over Phoenix Books from 12 to 4 with blind dates with a book and a trope scavenger hunt, and a Pitkin Street neighbor is throwing Roundup at the Roundabout , a circle themed block party at Strong and Blodgett streets from around 2 to 8 with foot races, crafts and hula hoops. Film buffs get Spike Lee's Malcolm X at the VTIFF screening room at 3. Raving for Recovery fills City Hall Park from 4:30 to 8 with free food, live music, DJs and dance parties celebrating Vermont's recovery community. Green Mountain Wrestling sets up outdoors at Switchback Brewing with doors at 5 and the first bell at 6, bring your own chair. As the sun goes down, the South Burlington Water Lantern Festival floats personalized lanterns onto the water at Overlook Park starting at 6:30. The night closes with Nora Brown and Stephanie Coleman playing a folk bill at the Higher Ground Ballroom at 8, and three local acts, Funkrust, Marxist Jargon and Faul Durand, playing Junktiques Collective with doors at 6:30 and music at 7.

days.label: Sunday
days.text: Sunday eases in before the rain. The Equinox Wind Quintet plays a free Sunday Classical program in the BCA Center gallery at 10, and the Winooski Farmers Market runs 10 to 2 at Winooski Falls Way. Riders can join a bike ride from Leddy Park to South Hero [MEETUP] at 10, about 20 miles round trip on the Island Line Trail with a snack stop at Allenholm Farm. The Lost Mural Project hosts Yiddish singer songwriter Daniel Kahn with violinist Jake Shulman-Ment at Ohavi Zedek Synagogue at 4:30, supertitles included. Burlington guitarist Bob Wagner releases his debut solo album at Flynn Space at 5 with Kat Wright and Nicole Nelson among the special guests. And if you want your line dancing on the water, the Country Line Dancing cruise ($59.99) sails aboard the Spirit of Ethan Allen at 6:30, an hour of instruction followed by 90 minutes of open dance. That one is an evening affair, so keep half an eye on the sky.
